Domain 1: Patient Selection/Study Design: Did the study include a range of activities concerning the 24-hour movement behaviour outcomes?
Did the study protocol include at least one activity with natural transitions? (NA for sleep studies)
Did the study provide comprehensive information about the inclusion/exclusion criteria of the recruiting process?
Did the study include at least a sample of 20 participants?
Was the classification/association method used in the prediction model reported and selected input features justified?

If a threshold was used, was it prespecified or was the threshold calibration process clearly described and justified? If training of non-threshold-based models was done, were the training procedures clearly described or further information cited?

Is the selected criterion measure the gold-standard for the respective outcome? (i.e., calorimetry or doubly labelled water for activity intensity or energy expenditure, video observation for activity type, and polysomnography for sleep)
Were the reference standards consistently applied across all participants? (NA for direct observation)
Did the authors provide detailed information about data synchronisation between the index and criterion measures? (NA for direct observation)
Were all participants included in the analyses, and if not, were reasons for exclusion and handling of missing data provided and justified?
Was the index measure validated against the criterion measure using independent datasets or cross-validation methods?
